top.en: Ultimately, it's mostly disappointment and regret. Last year at Worlds, our LPL teams generally struggled in the Swiss stage, and our 4th seed IG was sent home early by T1. You guys were the only ones who stepped up, beating GEN and HLE to go 3-0. It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say you were the only hope for the LPL back then. I made you my main team in the LPL during that time. It was a real [~N:shame] that you were one step away from beating T1 in the quarterfinals; that's still a sore spot for many. I knew that once you lost, the LPL's hope was gone. This year, after taking the 1st seed in the third split, everyone thought you could go further. On the first day, many people probably watched the LPL vs. LCK matches with a sour mood, hoping you'd win the next two to save some face, or they were just loyal fans. But after waiting so long, seeing you play like this is unacceptable. When you lost to TES, the audience could see where the problem was, because one more loss meant it was over. I knew you probably wouldn't go far and qualifying would be tough, but I still believed if you adjusted, you could fight back. I didn't watch this game because I was truly exhausted. When I woke up and saw a friend's message saying AL got swept, my heart sank. A 1st seed going out 0-3 is truly impressive. Even if you had won a few more games before being eliminated, people might not have blamed you so much. It's quite disappointing. Honestly, it's more of a sense of shock and reflection, but I'm still willing to thank you for your performance last year. You were once the LPL's only hope, but I probably won't hold any hope for this team in the future. Best of luck.

thread.zh:
在S1～S15（旧小组赛双循环赛制），LPL、LCK没有任何一支队伍世界赛正赛一把没赢就出局。
S8的Gen.G（三星）是LCK历史下限：1胜5负，至少拿下1个BO1胜场。LPL往年最差比如S5 LGD、S7 EDG、S11 FPX，全都有胜场。
直到 S16 今天的 AL，才出现中韩赛区第一支【大场0胜、小局全输出局】的队伍。
甚至我们把范围扩大，不局限于 s 赛，算上 msi，先锋赛，石油杯，AL 也是第一支一把不赢就回家的[破防]
thread.en: From S1 to S15 (the old group stage format), no LPL or LCK team had ever been eliminated from the main stage of Worlds without winning a single game. S8 Gen.G was the LCK's all-time low: 1-5, but at least they got one BO1 win. The worst LPL performances in previous years, like S5 LGD, S7 EDG, or S11 FPX, all had wins. It wasn't until S16 today with AL that we saw the first team from the Chinese or Korean regions to go 0-0 in series and 0-all in games. If we expand the scope beyond Worlds to include MSI, the Esports World Cup, and the Saudi Cup, AL is still the first team to go home without a single win [mental breakdown].

He was invisible for all of S11, had a disastrous S13, but because he played a bit better the last two years, everyone whitewashed his record. He was invisible for all of S11, had a disastrous S13, but because he played a bit better the last two years, everyone whitewashed his record. top.en: Look at this guy: when he wins, people praise him for 'carrying as a single core,' but when he loses, he wants to avoid all blame. In critical games, he always plays tanks, never steps up, and avoids responsibility. He was invisible throughout S11 and got knocked out in the Round of 16. In S13, he had a disastrous performance, but because he played a bit better in the last two years, everyone whitewashed his history. His Jarvan can't beat Nocturne, his Nocturne can't beat Jarvan, and he goes 0/0/0 at 20 minutes while dodging all blame. His fanboys spend all day fantasizing about him getting a huge contract from a top LCK team, but in reality, no one wants him. It’s hilarious to see a '41-jungler' who has only one league title in eight years of pro play.

thread.zh: 事实证明双败赛制就是垃圾赛制，一个被3：0打输的队，第二条命复活了然后一路赢到决赛，然后手感火热的打等了半个月的没有手感的胜者，然后胜者输了就输了没有第二条命，这不是明显不合理吗，你要搞双败你就搞到底，硬性规定每队都有两条命，不用完不算输，要么你就把别搞这烂双败，换单败还能看得刺激点
thread.en: Facts have proven that the double-elimination format is just garbage. A team gets 3-0'd, gets a second life, wins all the way to the finals, and then has to face a hot team that's been waiting for half a month with zero momentum, and if the winner loses they just lose with no second life. Isn't that obviously unreasonable? If you're gonna do double-elimination then commit to it and make a strict rule that every team gets two lives and it's not over until they're used up, or else ditch this garbage double-elimination and switch back to single-elimination so it's actually exciting to watch.
